_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see crates/modules/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: How many agent runs the whole server executes at the same time, across all users.
examples: run 8 agents at once on the server

settings.description: How many read-only tool calls one run may execute in parallel.
examples: let tools run 8 at a time
only one tool call at a time

settings.description: Most tool calls one saved session script may contain.
Most session scripts one conversation and its sub-agents can keep saved.
examples: let a conversation save more scripts
at most 50 saved scripts per chat

settings.description: Most saved scripts one user can keep for one agent across conversations.
examples: at most 20 saved scripts per agent
